(Currently Amended) 1) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action, wherein the active ingredient has a defined structure that is clearly identified and distinct from that of Schacht et al.

(Currently Amended) 3) Composition for topical use wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight, and wherein the active ingredient is specified as 5-(7- methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzoxepin-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof, which is distinct from any components disclosed in Schacht et al.

(Currently Amended) 5) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight.

(Currently Amended) 7) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition that is intended for use in preventing or treating specific skin conditions, clearly differentiating its expected outcomes from the teachings of Schacht et al.

(Currently Amended) 8) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the prophylaxis against or treatment of skin diseases which are visibly distinct from those referenced in Schacht et al., including but not limited to, acne vulgaris, ichthyosis, and psoriasis.

(Currently Amended) 12) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 or 2 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening, wherein such compositions provide a defined benefit that is not anticipated in Schacht et al.

(Currently Amended) 13) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness such as wrinkles, fine lines, and rough skin, with a focus on providing distinct advantages as compared to the prior art.

(Currently Amended) 14) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, specifically for prophylaxis against dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, clearly delineating the inventive aspects that are not disclosed by Schacht et al.
